page_title: LEC 0-3 ATA | Lecce v Atalanta 06/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90+3' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jamil Siebert (Lecce) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' A quickly taken corner by Atalanta.
90' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
89' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
87' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
84' Ederson (Atalanta) commits a foul during an attacking move.
82' Konan Ndri (Lecce) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
80' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Nikola Krstovic is replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
78' It is time for a substitution. Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is on for Walid Cheddira.
77' Ederson (Atalanta) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
77' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) decided to try his luck with a first-time shot. He probably immediately regrets his decision as he skies the ball out.

73' 0 - 3 A superb goal from great team play! Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the top left corner. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
73' Ederson (Atalanta) gets inside the box and tries to beat Wladimiro Falcone with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
70' The substitution has been made. Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) has replaced Berat Djimsiti.
70' It will be a substitution. Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is ready to enter the pitch as Davide Zappacosta walks off.
70' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is booked.
68' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) replaces Ylber Ramadani.
67' Danilo Veiga will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
67' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
65' Ederson (Atalanta) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) latches on to a cross but heads the ball miles wide of the right post. Such a bad header.
63' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Marten de Roon will be replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
63' That will be all from Nicola Zalewski who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).
59' 0 - 2 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Charles De Ketelaere, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
59' Lameck Banda (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
57' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' The ball is cleared after Omri Gandelman (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
53' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
52' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and it's Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
52' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Ederson (Atalanta) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
47' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Federico La Penna ignores the protests.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco makes a switch. Omri Gandelman is coming on in place of Sadik Fofana (Lecce) at the start of the second period.
46' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Ederson (Atalanta) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.
45+1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Ederson (Atalanta) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
43' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

42' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a brilliant save. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
41' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
36' Sadik Fofana (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
29' 0 - 1 Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
27' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Federico La Penna had a clear view and blows his whistle.
21' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
20' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
20' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Wladimiro Falcone hadn't made a superb save. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
17' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) sprays a pass out to Charles De Ketelaere, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
15' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
13' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) heads on.
11' Sadik Fofana (Lecce) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
10' The linesman raises his flag. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
6' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Federico La Penna blows his whistle for an infringement.
4' The free kick from long range, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Federico La Penna.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
